title: The Cross
message: The cross looks like defeat until you understand what happened on it. "He was wounded for our transgressions, He was bruised for our iniquities." Every sin that would have separated you from God was laid on Him instead of you. Jesus didn't come to be served — He came to serve, and to give His life as a ransom. The cross is where God's justice and God's love meet at the same point: sin is dealt with fully, and you are loved fully. Nothing you've done disqualifies you from what He already paid for.
explore: Sin, forgiveness, reconciliation, grace, sacrifice and freedom.
reflect: What does the cross reveal about God's love? What does it reveal about the seriousness of sin?
pray: Jesus, help me understand the depth of Your love and what You accomplished for me.
